Nashville, TN · Bakers

And She Bakes

Ask for pricing

Nashville-area baker booking 2026 wedding cakes, with tasting boxes or an in-home tasting. Pickup is from a Cane Ridge location about 25 minutes from downtown Nashville.

The weddings page lists a $55 tasting box and a $150 private tasting, credited toward larger cake orders, but it does not publish a wedding-cake starting price. The cakes page lists single-tier custom cakes from $125 for a 6-inch cake and an event-delivery minimum of $75. Those figures are not stated as the wedding-cake rate, so they are not used as the price. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · unpublished
